info.value: ASaMse syAdicCAyAM SaMsatIti stutO Bavet . hiMsAyAM Sasati ' (Slo. 183) iti devaH . ktvA - lyapoH vizaye atra viviDAni matAni kfdantarUpamAlAyAM darSitAni . ante ca liKyate - ' IdfSezu sTalezu prayogAH pAWAH ca aniyatAH dfSyante ' iti .

examples: 'agnihotriRi devatA aSaMsante' (mE0 saM0). ASaMsante kAmapUrtaye tatra lambante.
'na nUnaM mayi kEkeyi kiMcidASaMsase guRAn' (rA0 2.19.24). ASaMsase saMBAvayasi, jAnAsi.
'A tU na indra SaMsaya gozvaSvezu' (f0 1.29.1). ASaMsaya samantAtpraSastAn kurviti sAyaRaH.
'sa duzwaH pApamASaMsuH pARqavAnAM mahAtmanAm' (BA0 SAM0 39.25). pApamanizwamASaMsuricCuH.
'yadvE savAsA araRyaM nodASaMsate niDAya vE tadvAso'timucyate.' (Sa0 brA0 5.2.3.5). araRyaM na kAmayata ityAha. ucCabdo nArTe viSezaM karoti.
'vratacaryAM vA nodASaMsIta' (Apa0 SrO0 9.1.4.79). na SakzyAmi kartumityudIkzya nASaMsIta necCedityarTa iti rudradattaH.
